# QS-CFW-7189-64 — Quality specification - bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (52100)
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-7189-64  
This revision supersedes Rev B.

Scope
This document defines the material and dimensional quality requirements, inspection method, and nonconformance handling for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) manufactured at Plant P1. It applies to finished forgings presented for final inspection and release.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 52100 |
| Hardness | The hardness range for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is 22-26 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is ±0.06 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for bearing ring CFW-7189-64 (CFW-7189-64) is 22.9 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of laps, tears, and forging scale that compromise fit or function |

Inspection method
Visual inspection: Inspect each part for surface defects and dimensional conformity to the requirements table. Use calibrated measuring instruments appropriate to the feature and resolution required. Hardness testing: Perform hardness checks on representative locations using a calibrated rockwell hardness tester and record values. For bore diameter: measure at opposed locations using an internal micrometer or bore gauge and record all readings. Sampling: Inspect items in accordance with the plant inspection plan; ensure traceability to batch and heat lot.

Nonconformance handling
Suspect or nonconforming parts shall be tagged and segregated to prevent unintended use. Document nonconformance on the plant quality report and notify quality engineering. Disposition options include rework to requirements, use-as-is only with documented engineering approval, or scrap. Root cause analysis and corrective action shall be initiated for process or material causes to prevent recurrence.
